items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: Hot Lips Page took me down there and the musicians have helped me all through my career.

ctx.x: Small clubs and the theaters. We did the theater in Chicago and the Apollo of course when we came back to New York. And then Ella Johnson went back with the band. And then I went to 52nd Street to the Onyx Club. Hot Lips Page took me down there and the musicians have helped me all through my career. They would say, “This one is looking for a vocalist, you go.” And so that was how everything happened for me. Musicians have really been my friends, very dear, and they taught me, I’ve learned so much from them…
Well I think musicians and accompanists, they appreciate a relationship with a singer that’s back and forth, that they value when you’re learning something from them, and vice versa.
